thread:
violet: Quick postmortem follow-up 025-02-27. Noting recurring hotspot->DB-saturation pattern. I'll list short action items; please pick owners.

kai: Thx. We saw affinity causing a few shards to get 70% of canary traffic.

jun: Also saw high per-shard concurrency defaults (180+) which pushed DB queues above 95th.

violet: Proposed immediate guardrails:
- emergency rollback trigger: sustained p95 > 1.5s OR 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m -> try scale-down (50%) then rollback if no improvement after 30s
- default prod concurrency = 25; non-prod = 120; increases need risk review
- per-flag active-user hard cap + per-shard ceiling + global safety throttle
- randomize early-bucket hashing to avoid sticky routing

kai: I'll take randomized hashing + sampling QC (dashboard + CI test). Target: 2025-03-04.

jun: I'll own the rollback controller and the scale-down-first flow. Target: 2025-03-12. I'll add integration test that simulates DB backpressure.

ops-bot: system: canary start 2025-02-27T14:04Z 0 shards=3 concurrency=185 sample=0.05

violet: Operational: creating GH board "hotspot-guardrails" and label `hotspot-guardrail`. All items must be tracked with owner + due date + postmortem link. Weekly triage Wednesdays 10am PT.

kai: One nuance: some enterprise customers want higher throughput. We need per-customer opt-out + legal signoff. I'll add notes to the design doc.

jun: Corner case: prefer scale-down attempt before rollback for less customer disruption. We'll implement that ordering but keep rollback if metric not improving.

violet: Ok recap: hashing + QC (kai) 2025-03-04; rollback+scale-down (jun) 2025-03-12; blast-radius caps design (violet) 2025-03-18. Please ack and add any blockers to the board.

kai: Ack. Starting RFC now.

jun: Ack. Will post PR when tests are green.

ops-bot: tracker: created HOTSPOT-111 and scheduled weekly triage until resolved

violet: Thanks all 44d. If no objections I'll add to the postmortem and close thread.

kai: No objections.

jun: LGTM.

violet: Closing and will ping before first triage.
